findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed interior of kitchen microwave to be soiled with food splash and debris. Clean and sanitize interior of kitchen microwave. 

4-602.12: (A) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. This section does not apply to hot oil cooking and filtering EQUIPMENT if it is cleaned as specified in Subparagraph 4-602.11(D)(6). (B) The cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours by using the manufacturer's recommended cleaning procedure.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17  (Pf) Date marking is not on 2 opened gallon containers of milk. Food shall be clearly marked, at the time the original container is opened in a food establishment and if the food is held for more than 24 hours, to indicate the date or day by which the food shall be consumed on the premises, sold, or discarded, when held at a temperature of 41 deg F or less for a maximum of 7 days (not exceeding a manufacturer?s use-by date). Discussed applicable sections of 3-501.17 and reviewed HACCP concepts with person in charge. Food was discarded. Reference 3-501.17.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on ceiling vent in kitchen. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment: All Certified Food Protection Managers must complete an approved allergen training course.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed a cup being used as a scoop in a cereal container and two measuring cups to have the handle stored in contact with the cereal in other containers. All scoops should have handles and be stored with the handle extended up and out of the food.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed an in use serving utensil to be stored in the food with handle in contact with food. Store utensils with handle extending out of food or clean and dry.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the interior bottom of the milk cooler to be soiled with food splash and standing water. Clean the non-food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: No thermometer was observed in the fridge. Place a thermometer in the fridge.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
1) Observed single use cups being used as scoops in two bulk containers of dry cereal. 2) Observed scoops with handles in contact with food in one dry cereal container and one sugar container. Only use scoops with handles and ensure that the handles are extended out of the food to protect against potential cross contamination.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
No chlorine test strips were observed for the chlorine sanitizer during the inspection. Provide test strips for chlorine sanitizer.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed one rubber spatula with cracked edges.
750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.
*Discard the spatula.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Repeat:  Observed the cove molding not adhered to the wall located near the hand sink and the back door.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
*Seal the cove molding to the wall.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed several staff lunches on top of the cartons of milk in the milk cooler.
750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.
Store staff food and food for the children separate.  Corrected:  The staff food was moved.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the cove molding pulled away from the wall near the hand sink and back door.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
Re-seal the cove molding to the wall.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 800: The drainboard of the dish rack is soiled. Include the drainboard within the normal cleaning schedule to prevent soil accumulation. Clean the drainboard.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 750-880 Observed single service articles being stored under the handwashing sink and 3-compartment sink. The items were moved during the inspection. See general comments for details. Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Clean dishes stored on towels(blue) on the counter top. Section 750.860 Provide a dish drainer or like item for dishes.
